title: Looking For Devs (Discord at bottom If interested)
author: Ambitious-Garbage499
selftext:
Hi, i'm looking for devs to help me make my game come to life. I'm not a developer obviously could only do AI scripting. For Pay, either 20k robux or like 200 bucks. I'm looking for someone who can make what I ask come to life and a partner with me. Start small than grow so let me know if you are a developer interested or have friends and the more developers the better obviously. Only really looking for one or two right now but we can discuss later down the road. The game is an anime based game because as seen on roblox can become easily popular.

My Discord is waffle5619 (I was a kid when i made my account) DM if your serious about developing and dedicating time.

comments.author: ThaBombs
comments.body:
I can't say that I am or am not interested, I'd first of all need to know a lot more about what you actually want. 

I do also want to say that if it is even remotely complex 200 bucks will never cut it. 200 bucks is worth like maaaybe 10 hours of work if you find the right people. Also will need to take assets costs into account and token costs if it is auto build able using an AI.

comments.author: Cubey42
comments.body: Why not just ... Pay for ai and do it yourself?

comments.author: Jolly_Roger-99
comments.body:
What exatly you want to have? Sounds like you are young, its a good time to learn coding and other stuff.
Maybe you should spend your money on some decent books about programming.

comments.author: Cork20
comments.body:
> the more developers the better obviously

Oh my sweet summer child

comments.author: WhiplashNinja
comments.body:
Use the 200 get Claude max.

Don't use GPT.

Gpt has better memory across sessions, but that memory bleeds into projects and contaminates them.

Claude can't remember shit about who you are, and doesn't care, but he gets shit done.

comments.author: RocketSciense
comments.body:
If you don't have the cash then consider a revenue share model instead?

$200 is nothing in 2026. Bringing people on to help you build your dream should warrant sharing in the rewards a little more than a few tanks of gas.
